description: This is a React component file for rendering detailed views of individual test cases within a web-based HTML report for Playwright test runs. It manages displaying test metadata, results, annotations, navigation between test cases, and related UI elements.

methods.name: TestCaseAnnotationView
methods.description: Renders individual test annotation details with optional linkification and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: retryLabel
methods.description: Generates labels for test retries or initial runs based on index.
